title: Offer
description: The single pending-update offer of an engagement (DISENO S3 (b): Offer(target, since, status, previouslyDeclined[])).
$comment: Source: DISENO S3 (b); engagement_state (offerTarget, offerSince, offerStatus, previouslyDeclined); EV-17. Audience: public (via S7) and internal (S3). Residency: regional (cell of the firm).

target.description: Offer target version (version label issued by the Templates Service, not a uuid, e.g. 'v7').

previouslyDeclined.description: Version labels the user declined before that are contained in the target (annotation only, DEC-21; RF-050).
